newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telefonica Argentina EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telefonica Argentina EPS cut.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said on Wednesday it had cut its 1995-96 fiscal year estimate for Telefnica de Argentina's earnings per American Depositary Receipt (ADR) to $1.63 from $1.92.

-- Analysts Mickey Schleien and Marina Grande said in a report, "The First Call consensus is $1.82, but recent estimates are about $1.70. Our estimate for the September quarter is $0.34, which is slightly lower than recent estimates and below the $0.46 consensus."
-- They said they cut the estimate in part because of weak demand for access lines.
